meta.tolerance_rationale: scikit-learn 1.7.2 separates two consecutive sorted float32 values whenever they differ (FEATURE_THRESHOLD behaves as 0, not as the 1e-7 of _partitioner.pxd). With a 1e-7 gap none of these trees would be the same (same_tree_with_gap_1e-7, node_count_with_gap_1e-7). X is stored as the float32 values sklearn sees.

tree.threshold_float32_inputs: midpoint x[p-1]/2 + x[p]/2 in float64 of two consecutive DISTINCT float32 training values (X is cast to float32); leaves store -2
